tasks.analysis: Construction is the process of designing and building projects, which involve workers and machines. Construction work involves a number of different workers from construction managers, carpenters, builders, and construction workers, to masons, plasterers, electricians, and bricklayers. The process with which a construction project is completed involves several different parts.
